items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: And the opening was cute too. It showed a Rolls Royce going down the strip in Vegas at night, the marquees — Frank Sinatra, Wayne Newton, Elvis Presley

ctx.x: I had a local agent call me a couple of years ago and he said I have an Indian casino down in Scottsdale, Arizona. He said, “They’re really nice people and it’s an easy show during the week like on a Tuesday or Wednesday or Thursday you do one show and then a couple on weekends. And they do nice crowds. And the guy who runs the place is a fan of yours so he’ll pick up all your expenses and there’s a brand new condo they give you to stay in, fully equipped. It was a nice thing. It was not too far to drive. So I…
“Why thank you, my impersonations must have been a success.”
